name: Magma Storm
description: You stir up a maelstrom of fire in a 40 foot circle, centered on a point within range, that continues to rage as long as you hold your concentration. Any creature that enters this area for the first time on their turn, or is in that area at the beginning of their turn must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
